name: Eftel
summary: Telco (Datafast Telecommunications Ltd, ACN 073 238 178; ex-Goldminco NL, renamed Datafast Telecom 1999) that grew by acquisitions as the Eftel ISP brand from 2000; took over Vivanet (2001); legally renamed EFTel Ltd 15 Dec 2005; ClubTelco reverse takeover 2011; acquired by M2 Group 2013, business unit closed 2022.

events.details: Incorporated (Goldminco NL); renamed Datafast Telecommunications 5 Oct 1999; the Eftel ISP brand was used from 2000 (Perth); legally renamed EFTel Ltd 15 Dec 2005.
The two names[] rows overlap in date range: the Eftel brand (in use from 2000) predates the 15 Dec 2005 legal rename of Datafast Telecommunications Ltd (same ACN 073 238 178).
Reverse takeover by ClubTelco 2011 (ClubTelco interests took 75.6% of the listed shell); delisted 14 Jun 2013 (M2 acquisition, ~A$44.1m); business unit closed 2022.
